newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 24.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Tuesday's Daily Variety:
* ABC executive Stuart Bloomberg is expected to be named chairman of ABC Entertainment, edging out ABC Entertainment president Jamie Tarses, sources said.
* Reed-Elsevier agreed to acquire Walt Disney's trade magazine publisher Chilton Business Group for $447 million in cash.

* Babaloo Mandel, who has written a string of hit comedies such as "City Slickers" with partner Lowell Ganz, is about to write a script by himself called "Joe's Dream," about a pilot's unusual journey.
* Dana Walden has been promoted to senior vice president of drama at News Corp Ltd's 20th Century Fox TV.
* Barbara Brogliatti, top television public relations executive for Warner Bros., has been named to the newly created position of senior vice president of corporate communications for the studio.
* A Los Angeles Superior Court judge ordered Walt Disney to hand over documents requested by former Disney Studios Chairman Jeffrey Katzenberg in his lawsuit against the compay.
* Kirch Group and Bertelsmann AG have agreed to become equal partners in pay TV broadcaster Premiere, ending a long battle for position in the German pay-TV market.
